sentences.l2: 周五下班后，我们部门决定把这次团建安排在附近的KTV。
sentences.l1: After work on Friday, our department decided to hold this team-building event at a nearby KTV.

sentences.l2: 大家原本只是想在忙碌一周后放松一下，没想到这场唱歌聚会成了增进彼此感情的好机会。
sentences.l1: Everyone had originally just wanted to relax after a busy week, and did not expect this singing party to become a good opportunity to deepen our feelings for one another.

sentences.l2: 刚进包间时，有人有些拘谨，只点了几首熟悉的歌；后来，平时话不多的同事也拿起话筒，唱起自己最喜欢的老歌。
sentences.l1: When we first entered the private room, some people were a bit reserved and only picked a few familiar songs; later, colleagues who usually did not talk much also picked up the microphone and sang their favorite old songs.

sentences.l2: 办公室里总被忽略的细节，也在笑声和掌声中慢慢浮现。
sentences.l1: Details that are always overlooked in the office also slowly surfaced amid the laughter and applause.

sentences.l2: 有人是标准的麦霸，一首接一首，气氛热烈；也有人安静坐在角落，为大家点歌、倒水，同样让聚会变得温暖。
sentences.l1: Some are standard mic hogs, one song after another, with a lively atmosphere; there were also people who sat quietly in the corner, picking songs and pouring water for everyone, which likewise made the party warm.

sentences.l2: 通过这次团建，我们不仅听到了同事歌声里的情绪，也更理解了彼此在工作中的压力与坚持。
sentences.l1: Through this team-building event, we not only heard the emotions in our colleagues' singing, but also better understood one another's pressure and perseverance at work.

sentences.l2: 唱歌不只是娱乐，它让团队从简单的合作关系，变成了更有默契、更愿意互相支持的集体。
sentences.l1: Singing is not just entertainment; it turned the team from a simple working relationship into a collective with more tacit understanding and more willingness to support one another.
